S.FORM: kgi ga 'yaya stinun naha, kgi ga pnuhi na Tayal nanak, kutun naha kgi laga, mkgi ro bkuyan naha wayey kya, ro stinun naha lukus Tayal kya. kilgal kbaley lukus nya sbiru suruw: gmegey nuka:kutun naha kgi laga slayun naha abow kgi, hakut naha ro cyan naha bih kyan syasiy kya, s'agal naha ruma ro kgusun naha yula', ro mkgi naha, ro srpux naha kgi ro gmegey naha nuka ro wagan naha bulit ro pgyan naha tanux. p'ubuy wayey ro bkuy wayey: slyun kwara nuka gnegey naha ro inbuyan naha kwara wayey. phagay wayey: s'agal naha phgayan wayey ro phagey wayey, tmwang khtuw ro musa hyuti ci ha'iy wayey. tmahu' wayey: tmagan 'sya ro bulit wayey ro thkun iyik bih tupih, sa'ing tmuting tpuyan ta, inwaxan urow nya ro galun syup nya, ro musa mlabuw wayey. "gaga cinmagan wayey hiya, tgmagan bulit ga musa mlabuw wayey haca, tmagan maci ro thpuyan ga musa mtalah, ro mtalah ha'iy." kkbalay na latan Tayan hiya maga mutuw naha skahun sku kgiy muwah kbalay,utux utux sali ga niya mmuhiy na kgiy, kgiy hani ga aw mutuw pinhyun sku ryax na tmangu abaw, 'bagan, ru mshuw abaw. pinhyun nya sku rhyan hiya ga siki msmi tikay ru blay ms'uraw na rhyan, pyang blay ga siki mtesuruw na syax witux mutuw yenga pinhtgan sa wawi ru kthuy helaw balay mrkyas, ana wayay nuka nya ga mutuw blay pinhtgan nya. sraral kgi ga klayun ta lukus ru pala. Bnrwan qa galan cpung 教育部-朗聲四起
S.PHON: kɣi ɣa ʔjaja [s|ɕ]tinun naħa kɣi ɣa pnuħi na tajal nanak kutun naħa kɣi laɣa mkɣi ro βkujan naħa wajej kja ro [s|ɕ]tinun naħa luku[s|ɕ] tajal kja kilɣal kβalej luku[s|ɕ] nja [s|ɕ]βiru [s|ɕ]uruw ɣmeɣej nukakutun naħa kɣi laɣa [s|ɕ]lajun naħa aβow kɣi ħakut naħa ro [ʦ|ʨ]jan naħa βiħ kjan [s|ɕ]ja[s|ɕ]ij kja [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal naħa ruma ro kɣu[s|ɕ]un naħa julaʔ ro mkɣi naħa ro [s|ɕ]rpux naħa kɣi ro ɣmeɣej naħa nuka ro waɣan naħa βulit ro pɣjan naħa tanux pʔuβuj wajej ro βkuj wajej [s|ɕ]ljun kwara nuka ɣneɣej naħa ro inβujan naħa kwara wajej pħaɣaj wajej [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal naħa pħɣajan wajej ro pħaɣej wajej tmwaŋ kħtuw ro mu[s|ɕ]a ħjuti [ʦ|ʨ]i ħaʔij wajej tmaħuʔ wajej tmaɣan ʔ[s|ɕ]ja ro βulit wajej ro tħkun ijik βiħ tupiħ [s|ɕ]aʔiŋ tmutiŋ tpujan ta inwaxan urow nja ro ɣalun [s|ɕ]jup nja ro mu[s|ɕ]a mlaβuw wajej ɣaɣa [ʦ|ʨ]inmaɣan wajej ħija tɣmaɣan βulit ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mlaβuw wajej ħa[ʦ|ʨ]a tmaɣan ma[ʦ|ʨ]i ro tħpujan ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mtalaħ ro mtalaħ ħaʔij kkβalaj na latan tajan ħija maɣa mutuw naħa [s|ɕ]kaħun [s|ɕ]ku kɣij muwaħ kβalajutux utux [s|ɕ]ali ɣa nija mmuħij na kɣij kɣij ħani ɣa aw mutuw pinħjun [s|ɕ]ku rjax na tmaŋu aβaw ʔβaɣan ru m[s|ɕ]ħuw aβaw pinħjun nja [s|ɕ]ku rħjan ħija ɣa [s|ɕ]iki m[s|ɕ]mi tikaj ru βlaj m[s|ɕ]ʔuraw na rħjan pjaŋ βlaj ɣa [s|ɕ]iki mte[s|ɕ]uruw na [s|ɕ]jax witux mutuw jeŋa pinħtɣan [s|ɕ]a wawi ru ktħuj ħelaw βalaj mrkja[s|ɕ] ana wajaj nuka nja ɣa mutuw βlaj pinħtɣan nja [s|ɕ]raral kɣi ɣa klajun ta luku[s|ɕ] ru pala βnrwan qa ɣalan [ʦ|ʨ]puŋ *******
